name: – Siegfried Mureşan, Carla Tavares – § 80 – Am 52
title: INTERIM REPORT on the proposal for a Council regulation laying down the Multiannual Financial Framework for the years 2028 to 2034
part_text: 80. Notes that, despite its flexibility, the 2028-2034 MFF proposal provides for a disproportionate increase in the EU budget and that the overall amounts proposed are excessive;
